title: Agents and Business Managers of Artists, Performers, and Athletes
description: Represent and promote artists, performers, and athletes in dealings with current or prospective employers. May handle contract negotiation and other business matters for clients.

tasks.text: Collect fees, commissions, or other payments, according to contract terms.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — In-person payment handling; some digital automation

dwas.name: Collect payments for goods or services.

tasks.text: Send samples of clients' work and other promotional material to potential employers to obtain auditions, sponsorships, or endorsement deals.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Campaign content and analysis drafted; human executes strategy

dwas.name: Distribute promotional literature or samples to customers.

tasks.text: Keep informed of industry trends and deals.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI surfaces updates; human internalizes knowledge

tasks.text: Conduct auditions or interviews to evaluate potential clients.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Live interview judgment and rapport; AI can only screen

tasks.text: Negotiate with managers, promoters, union officials, and other persons regarding clients' contractual rights and obligations.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Collective bargaining is high-stakes live negotiation

dwas.name: Arrange collective bargaining agreements.
dwas.gwa_name: Resolving Conflicts and Negotiating with Others

tasks.text: Confer with clients to develop strategies for their careers, and to explain actions taken on their behalf.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Written correspondence to customers is largely automatable

dwas.name: Correspond with customers to answer questions or resolve complaints.
dwas.gwa_name: Performing for or Working Directly with the Public

tasks.text: Develop contacts with individuals and organizations, and apply effective strategies and techniques to ensure their clients' success.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Business relationships require human trust and presence

tasks.text: Schedule promotional or performance engagements for clients.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Planning aided; on-site execution is human

dwas.name: Organize special events.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Arrange meetings concerning issues involving their clients.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Planning aided; on-site execution is human

dwas.name: Organize special events.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Manage business and financial affairs for clients, such as arranging travel and lodging, selling tickets, and directing marketing and advertising activities.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Marketing content and plans drafted; human executes

tasks.text: Hire trainers or coaches to advise clients on performance matters, such as training techniques or performance presentations.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI coordinates admin; human owns hiring decisions

dwas.name: Administer personnel recruitment or hiring activities.

tasks.text: Prepare periodic accounting statements for clients.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Standard financial documents drafted from data

tasks.text: Obtain information about or inspect performance facilities, equipment, and accommodations to ensure that they meet specifications.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical spec verification of facilities/equipment

dwas.name: Inspect facilities or equipment to ensure specifications are met.

tasks.text: Advise clients on financial and legal matters, such as investments and taxes.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Compliance guidance drafted; human verifies and owns

dwas.name: Advise others on legal or regulatory compliance matters.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

dwas.name: Recommend investments to clients.
